steps.intro: A new 150 ft savanna hilltop (seed 1234), never saved. a_* serves D:/dev/plantgen/out/lib_slice (the plain savanna library); b_* serves D:/dev/plantgen/out/lib_s12a, the same library with dry_grass slope_min_deg 15, shrub and acacia_young slope_min_deg 12, acacia a slope curve that is 1 to 10 degrees and 0 at 20, and palm a height curve. Same cameras; fades off, wind frozen.
